changelog: 🚀 Phase 4 Upgrade: Android Native JNI Layer (`libantibot_native.so`): 120 FPS Compose UI rendering via zero-allocation ARM64 Rust markdown token parser.
⚡ Native Markdown AST & Inline Spans: Replaces slow regexes with sub-millisecond Rust tokenization for math, code, lists, callouts, and tables.
🛡️ Native Unified Diff & SHA256: Zero-copy JNI acceleration for Git file comparisons and file hashing without subprocess overhead.
